Markets.title: US stocks today:US stocks open lower as high-stakes Iran, inflation tests loom
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks opened lower on Monday as investors weighed rising geopolitical tensions with Iran and awaited upcoming inflation data. Markets were also focused on Nvidia's upcoming quarterly results and the broader outlook for interest rates and AI valuations.

Markets.title: Iran's currency rial hits record low as US plans more sanctions
Markets.summary: Iran's currency dropped to a record low of 2.02 million rials per US dollar due to double-digit inflation, negative growth, and a naval blockade. The currency's decline reflects mounting economic distress as Washington prepares to impose additional sanctions.

Markets.title: Lenskart Solutions among 4 stocks to hit 52-week highs & surge up to 20% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite a 172-point drop in the Sensex on Monday, four BSE 200 stocks bucked the market trend to reach new 52-week highs. Lenskart Solutions, Siemens, AU Small Finance Bank, and United Spirits all showed strong investor interest and recent gains of up to 20% over the past month.

Markets.title: Sebi introduces IT Resilience Index for market infrastructure institutions: Here's what you need to know
Markets.summary: SEBI has launched a 100-point IT Resilience Index to evaluate the cybersecurity and operational systems of market infrastructure institutions. These institutions will be assessed twice a year across nine parameters, with real-time monitoring and early-warning systems required by February 2027.

Markets.title: Global Markets: Fast-fashion giant Shein shrinks value to up to $27 billion in Hong Kong IPO
Markets.summary: Fast-fashion giant Shein plans to raise up to $1.8 billion in a Hong Kong initial public offering with a reduced valuation of up to $27 billion. The company's valuation has dropped about 70% from its private market peak due to slower growth and rising competition, with trading expected to begin on September 1.

Geo-Political.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight Ukrainian strikes targeted warehouses belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-biggest online retailer. The affected facilities are located across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar.

Geo-Political.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States will completely sever all economic ties with Iran in what he called its greatest financial offensive ever. He also stated that any nation continuing to partner financially with Iran will face international isolation.

Geo-Political.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's King Harald remains hospitalized for a bloodstream bacterial infection. The royal palace reported that his health has worsened.

Geo-Political.title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
Geo-Political.summary: China has recalled nearly three million Tesla vehicles due to a safety issue involving hidden door handles. The recall also impacts several other car manufacturers, including Chinese brands XPeng, Xiaomi, and Geely.

Geo-Political.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
Geo-Political.summary: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration are underway as a crucial deadline for filing an election petition approaches. Critics and legal teams report that access to Zambian courts is currently being prevented.

Geo-Political.title: Sonya Massey's killer Sean Grayson dies in US prison
Geo-Political.summary: Former US police officer Sean Grayson, convicted of killing Sonya Massey, has died in prison while receiving cancer treatment. His original crime had reignited national debates regarding police brutality in the United States.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a combined GDP of $15 trillion. Goyal is currently visiting Japan with a delegation of over 200 business representatives to strengthen bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: On August 24, the Iranian rial dropped 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar. The currency's decline follows US President Donald Trump's announcement of a new "crushing economic operation" against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: India's service producer prices showed mixed results in the first quarter of the fiscal year, using a 2022-23 base year. Air passenger services experienced a significant 32% surge during this period, while aggregate weights were not assigned because the data does not cover the entire sector.

Data & Insights.title: AI, semicon, global value chains: How globalization isn't dying—it's evolving
Data & Insights.summary: Global trade is shifting away from traditional goods toward services and strategic technologies like semiconductors and AI. Rather than disappearing, globalization is transforming as supply chains and capital investments are reconfigured worldwide.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Hawkish RBI minutes, drought warning, rural workforce
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights recent Mint reports featuring hawkish Reserve Bank of India minutes, drought warnings, and rural workforce trends. The insights are presented through easy-to-read charts to help readers delve deeper into these economic topics.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments across sectors like IT, AI, and manufacturing under eased norms for land-border nations. However, it remains unclear whether the origin of these investments is from China.

India.title: Fake Delhi Call Centre Offering Air India Job Busted, 3 Arrested
India.summary: Delhi Police arrested three people for running a fake call centre that defrauded job seekers by offering false positions at Air India. The suspects collected money from victims for registration and employment fees through UPI transfers.

India.title: 0.1% Of Kumbh Budget Could Have Saved 125 Marathi Schools: Top Court Judge
India.summary: Supreme Court Judge Justice PB Varale stated that just 0.1 percent of the Nashik Kumbh Mela budget could have prevented 100 to 125 Marathi-medium schools from shutting down. He made this remark while highlighting the misallocation of public funds amid the closure of regional language schools.

India.title: Ajit Doval In Beijing For 25th Round Of India-China Boundary Talks
India.summary: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is in Beijing to attend the 25th round of India-China boundary talks. Bilateral ties have been severely strained since the Galwan Valley military clash in 2020.

India.title: Bihar Exam Officer's 'Dogs Bark' Remark For Protesters Triggers Row
India.summary: A Bihar exam officer triggered a controversy after comparing student protesters to barking dogs. Opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav visited the protest site in Gardanibagh to support the students and demanded an apology from the official.

India.title: 'Line That Cannot Be Crossed': Conrad Sangma's Warning On Shillong Violence
India.summary: Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma described recent violence in Shillong as very unfortunate. He warned that the government will take strict action against those responsible for creating fear.

India.title: Suspect In Manipur Ambush That Killed Colonel, Wife And Son In 2021 Arrested
India.summary: A joint team of security forces arrested 28-year-old Thiyam Boycha Singh in Manipur on Saturday. He is suspected of involvement in the 2021 ambush that killed a colonel, his wife, and their son.

General.title: UK missiles offer may help Ukraine - but they are not what Zelensky needs most
General.summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is providing blueprints to help Kyiv build its own long-range missiles. However, these missiles do not fully meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's primary military needs.

General.title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
General.summary: Five years after the Taliban's return to power, BBC journalists observed senior figures as the group reshapes Afghanistan. The reporting highlights how the regime maintains control through various societal changes, including matters related to divorce and smartphones.

General.title: Snooker champion Graeme Dott guilty of child sex abuse
General.summary: The former world champion was found guilty of lewd and libidinous behaviour towards a girl and boy.

General.title: Race Across the World star Jo Gardiner dies aged 61 one year after son's death
General.summary: Former *Race Across the World* contestant Jo Gardiner has died of cancer at the age of 61. Her death comes exactly one year after her son died in a vehicle crash.

General.title: Victims describe 'house of terror' abuse by mother, grandmother and stepfather
General.summary: Shirley Freeman, Julia Stephen, and David McColl subjected their victims to beatings, starvation, and psychological torment. The victims described the abuse as occurring in a "house of terror."

General.title: 'It's not Alton Towers' - rows break out over queuing at Wales' highest mountain
General.summary: Disagreements have broken out on Yr Wyddfa, Wales' highest mountain, between hikers waiting in line and others skipping the queue to reach the summit. The conflict highlights growing tensions over visitor management and etiquette at the popular peak.
